sentences.en: Biff and Wilma went to the pantomime.
sentences.zh: Biff 和 Wilma 去看哑剧表演。

sentences.en: The pantomime was about Robin Hood.

sentences.en: Robin Hood was a good man.

sentences.en: He lived in a wood with his men.

sentences.en: Everyone liked Robin Hood.

sentences.en: And they gave a cheer every time he came in.
sentences.zh: 大家都喜欢罗宾汉，每次他出场时，大家都会欢呼。

sentences.en: There was a bad man called the Sheriff.
sentences.zh: 有个坏人，名叫“郡长”。

sentences.en: Nobody liked the Sheriff.
sentences.zh: 没有人喜欢治安官。

sentences.en: He wanted to catch Robin Hood and lock him up.
sentences.zh: 他想抓住罗宾汉，把他关起来。

sentences.en: 'Look out, Robin!' Shouted the children.

sentences.en: The next day, Wilma and Anneena went to play with Robin Hood.

sentences.en: "You locked people up in it," Said the man.
sentences.zh: “你把人关在里面！” 那人说道。

He put in his head and his hands.
